title: Digital channels acceptance dossier and implementation readiness gate
workflow: Index each of 19 draft channel specifications and unresolved dependencies
Verify institutional authorization for enabled product/channel combinations
Review API contracts, roles, privacy, mobile UX and fraud/error states
Build and execute security, accessibility, replay and payment-state tests in proper environments
Collect independent finance/legal/operations/QA approvals with actual logs
Accept only qualified safe components and publish remaining gaps without fabricated readiness
invariants: 20 created CHN archive checkpoints do not equal 20 accepted work packages
A mock transfer confirmation is not settlement evidence or banking code
Account/payment P0 holds remain operative despite channel presentation completion
No customer data is released to partners solely from OAuth app registration
Missing test or reviewer evidence must remain NOT_RUN or BLOCKED
Production go-live requires independent institution and regulator-specific approvals where applicable
Every approval is bound to exact revision, environment, legal entity and source evidence
acceptance_tests: Trace each planned screen flow to approved backend permissions
Cross-tenant IDOR, stale session and duplicate payment command tests
Unknown payment outcome never displayed as settled
Acceptance pack rejects fabricated test pass or unapproved regulator interpretation
independent_gate: Approved institution channel scope, full 15-point implementation DoR, executed acceptance cases and independently signed security/finance/operations release criteria.
